Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 23 September 2025(Tuesday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan and Metro Manila.
